date.description: UTC day, YYYY-MM-DD; not in the future.

tools.name: publish_library_brief

Cannot apply labels or alter the assignment queue. Invoke only as part of the user's requested brief job.

document.description: The brief, at most 8,192 UTF-8 bytes.

citations.description: At most 20 citations: item_id, source_revision, card_hash, excerpt_id, quote (1-500 code points), evidence_kind, start, end.

usage.description: Client-reported usage, or null when unavailable (never zero).

tools.name: export_cited_range

end.description: Range end in seconds; must equal the last selected cue's end (with start).

media_revision.description: Optional pin; refuses revision_unavailable on change.

result.instructions: Uoink turns videos, playlists, and podcast episodes into local AI-ready corpora. Use the tools to capture, transcribe, publish, search, inspect, and analyze saved uoinks.

tools.name: uoink_video
tools.description: Extract a single YouTube video into a Uoink corpus.

tools.name: uoink_playlist
tools.description: Start asynchronous extraction for a YouTube playlist.

tools.name: get_job_status
tools.description: Return the full status object for an async Uoink job.

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.description: Cancel an async Uoink job and leave partial outputs on disk.

tools.name: list_recent_uoinks
tools.description: List recent saved Uoink corpora.

tools.name: search_uoinks
tools.description: Keyword search across saved Uoink markdown corpora.

tools.name: search_clips
tools.description: Full-text search over transcript windows from saved uoinks; each hit carries a deep link to the moment. Use this to find the exact quotable passage; use search_uoinks to find whole items.

tools.name: get_evidence_card
tools.description: Return an evidence card for one saved uoink: metadata, source URL, a short summary hint, and its most quotable clips spread across the timeline, each with a deep link. Resolve by slug or video_id. profile 'full' (default) or 'librarian' (bounded).

tools.name: get_uoink_corpus
tools.description: Return the full markdown corpus for a saved uoink by slug.

tools.name: analyze_comments
tools.description: Run Comment Intelligence on an existing uoink using the configured Anthropic key.

tools.name: classify_hook
tools.description: Classify the hook type for an existing uoink.

tools.name: get_taxonomy
tools.description: Return captured Hook Type taxonomy rows, optionally filtered by channel and hook_type.

tools.name: get_citation_map
tools.description: Return the transcript + screenshot citation map for a saved uoink, each entry with a source-aware timestamp link.

tools.name: get_uoink_health
tools.description: Return the per-section extraction health score for a saved uoink.

tools.name: find_mentions
tools.description: Find every mention of an entity (person, tool, product, company, or topic) across saved uoinks, each with a source-aware timestamp link when the source has a public URL.

tools.name: get_transcript_reliability
tools.description: Return stored transcript reliability spans for a saved uoink.

tools.name: add_podcast_feed
tools.description: Register a podcast RSS or Atom feed for metadata watching, with optional per-feed Auto-ingest.

tools.name: list_podcast_feeds
tools.description: List registered podcast feeds.

tools.name: remove_podcast_feed
tools.description: Remove a podcast feed and its tracked episode rows.

tools.name: poll_podcast_feed
tools.description: Fetch one podcast feed now and retain newly discovered episodes.

tools.name: list_podcast_episodes
tools.description: List tracked podcast episodes with optional feed and status filters.

tools.name: download_podcast_episode
tools.description: Download one episode's MP3 locally with yt-dlp and ffmpeg.

tools.name: get_whisperx_status
tools.description: Report local WhisperX availability and supported models.

tools.name: transcribe_podcast_episode
tools.description: Queue one local podcast transcription and return its durable job id.

tools.name: episode_to_corpus
tools.description: Publish a completed podcast transcript into the local corpus.

tools.name: get_library_activity
tools.description: Report deterministic library activity, shelf churn, and source observations.

start.description: Gregorian UTC timestamp YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.sssZ

end.description: Gregorian UTC timestamp YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.sssZ

tools.name: search_library
tools.description: Bounded clip-first search of the saved library (default 5, at most 20 hits) with an item-text fallback for items without clips. Each hit carries the item id, source revision, safe title and link, evidence kind and timing, a 240-character preview and revision-bound card and excerpt URIs for read_library_resource. Results are bounded, not exhaustive; follow next_step when more retrieval is needed.

tools.name: get_library_item
tools.description: Resolve one saved item by video_id or slug (exactly one) and return its default Librarian evidence card unchanged plus canonical card, excerpt and initial corpus-chunk URIs. Bounded; use before quoting.

tools.name: read_library_resource
tools.description: Read one uoink://library/v1/ resource URI (card, excerpt, corpus chunk, shelf page or brief) with the same validation, contents and refusals as resources/read. Fallback for clients without native resource reads; identical text, one renderer.

tools.name: get_library_brief_input
tools.description: Prepare bounded input for a client-run daily brief: for a UTC date and a Phase 2 run id, return job_key, input_hash, bound queue/run/projection revisions, capture and event counts, coverage, up to 20 work-status rows and up to 5 default Librarian cards (at most 24,576 bytes). Read only: no lease, no mutation. The client tracks its own report job.

date.description: UTC day, YYYY-MM-DD; not in the future.

tools.name: publish_library_brief
tools.description: Local write: persist one client-produced brief for a job prepared by get_library_brief_input. Validates the packet against current library data (stale_brief on change), binds every citation to supplied evidence, is idempotent on submission_key, and stores an immutable artifact under the local reach/briefs directory. Cannot apply labels or alter the assignment queue. Invoke only as part of the user's requested brief job.

input_packet.description: The exact packet returned by get_library_brief_input.

submission_key.description: Client idempotency key (1-200 characters, no whitespace).

document.description: The brief, at most 8,192 UTF-8 bytes.

citations.description: At most 20 citations: item_id, source_revision, card_hash, excerpt_id, quote (1-500 code points), evidence_kind, start, end.

usage.description: Client-reported usage, or null when unavailable (never zero).

tools.name: export_cited_range
tools.description: Read-only cited export of one stored transcript range (exact cue-aligned start/end, at most 120 s and 200 cues) or one current excerpt id from a saved item: verbatim stored text, per-cue speaker labels with provenance, overlapping chapters, safe source and seek links, source/media revisions and evidence refs. Nothing is fetched, transcribed or saved; refusals carry a next_step.

start.description: Range start in seconds; must equal the first selected cue's start (with end).

end.description: Range end in seconds; must equal the last selected cue's end (with start).

excerpt_id.description: A current excerpt id (instead of start/end).

source_revision.description: Optional pin; refuses revision_unavailable on change.

media_revision.description: Optional pin; refuses revision_unavailable on change.
